feeds.title: Alberta Mamas
feeds.description: Alberta Mamas is a collective started by seasoned bloggers, social media managers, and business owners. We are a community looking for contributing mom & dad bloggers across Alberta. Our goal is to create a community for all parents in Alberta. We are a platform for all things mom & dad from birth, beyond, and everything in between.

feeds.title: Life of Dr. Mom Blog
feeds.description: Life of Dr. Mom is designed for the modern mom who struggles with balancing family, work, and fun. With her experience working in women's health, postnatal care, mental health, and Pediatrics. Dr. Mom works to educate the modern mom with the most relevant up-to-date medical evidence to support families and the healthy development of their children.

feeds.title: Ang Hill Blog
feeds.description: Explore effortless, timeless design pieces that are made especially for the everyday woman, Designed by a busy mother who appreciates the value of time and simple elegance. Ang Hill is an ethical women's clothing brand inspired by the power of femininity and the pursuit of passion and with a vision to create a capsule wardrobe of timeless pieces that can easily be mixed and matched to create gorgeous outfits.

feeds.title: Edmonton Mama
feeds.description: Edmonton Mama blog by Michelle has been Edmonton's most trafficked and trusted local resource for parents since 2011. She shares things to do in and around YEG with the family, Mom life, New local family-friendly discoveries, experiences, tips, highlight reel, traveling as a family, and real life - all of it, with the hope of reaching out and connecting with Edmonton & area parents.

feeds.title: Chandeliers and Champagne
feeds.description: Welcome to Chandeliers and Champagne! I'm Holly, an Edmonton mom blogger sharing my passion for home decor, the pretty things in life, and all things, baby. Expect to find my latest decor finds, lots of pinks, many glasses of champagne, and countless photos of two strawberry blonde, blue-eyed cuties, my kids.

feeds.title: Honey & Betts
feeds.description: Honey & Betts blog by Hannah Kaup shares the best and most innovative products in women's, men's, and children's fashion; beauty; lifestyle; food, and technology. Hannah is a content creator and dark chocolate lover. She works with Edmonton and Canadian entrepreneurs and brands to share the best products and experiences.

feeds.title: The Cassie Paige
feeds.description: Cassie Paige is a YEG fashion blogger and lifestyle content creator who writes posts about life, fashion, reviews, and family. She shares amazing shopping tips on Amazon, style guides, and the experiences of being a mother in this personal blog.

feeds.title: Just Another Edmonton Mommy
feeds.description: Discover events and fun activities happening around Edmonton. Just Another Edmonton Mommy is a resource to connect families to events and activities in Edmonton & beyond, product reviews, DIYs, and more. Christine Bruckmann is a content creator and a local Edmonton mom who loves to explore everything that the Edmonton area has to offer.

feeds.title: Kari Skelton
feeds.description: I'm Kari Skelton. here, you can read about what works best for me and my family. Some of my posts are style-related, some focus on adventures in parenting my toddler Wyatt, and some shine light on the rest of my world. We're all looking for ways to make the most of our endeavors. The best way to do that is by sharing ideas and experiences.

feeds.title: Kristina Lynne
feeds.description: This is a design and lifestyle blog that centers on creating a lifestyle inspired by Kristina Lynne's beautiful interior design combined with being a new mother. Much of the blog focuses on incredible before & after transformations as Kristina and her husband, Ryan, buy, renovate and sell homes.

feeds.title: Mommy Connections Blog
feeds.description: Learn from local experts, experience new activities, and socialize with other moms at similar stages of their motherhood. Mommy Connections is a place for young mothers and their babies to learn, laugh and connect with others in a meaningful way. Our programs include informative discussions led by local experts, an opportunity to try new activities, and meeting other supportive moms.
